newsitem.title: USA: Continental says mediator named in talks.
newsitem.headline: Continental says mediator named in talks.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc on Thursday said the National Mediation Board assigned Harry Bickford as mediator in the contract negotiations with its pilots union.

Continental said the airline and the Independent Association of Continental Pilots had requested mediation after its offer of a double-digit pay increase over six years was rejected by the union, which said the proposal would leave wages below industry standards.

Bickford had mediated a contract settlement between Continental and its pilots two years ago. That agreement gave the pilots a 19 percent wage increase over two years and $30 million in lump sum payments, Continental said.
The pilots' current contract with Continental, the nation's fifth-largest airline, becomes amendable on June 30.

Michael Campbell, Continental's human resources and labor relations chief, on Thursday said the airline was confident that with the assistance of Bickford, the company and its pilots would be able to reach early resolution of contract issues.
